text:
Great question! Here's what happens with gift orders at Leafy:

**Pricing:** No — prices are never printed on gift packing slips, so your sister won't see what you paid. ✓

**Message:** Yes — you can add a **free printed gift note** with up to 200 characters. You'll have the option to include this when you place the order.

So you're all set to send a surprise without revealing the cost, and she'll get a personal message from you with the plant!

Is there anything else you'd like to know about your gift order?
